blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Smart glasses can help users understand their activities and surroundings, but small vision-language models must preserve useful evidence within limited computation. This is difficult because redundant frames consume the visual budget, while aggressive spatial compression can discard relevant details. Although gaze identifies the wearer's focus, the question may require evidence from the surrounding scene. To address these constraints, we propose GazeLens, which combines frame selection with gaze- and question-guided token reduction. First, HOG transitions and image sharpness select frames before visual encoding. For each selected frame, Gaussian pooling then forms gaze-focused and complementary summaries. Because their relevance depends on the question, a lightweight gate blends them into a primary token. Together with a global scene token, this retains both focused and contextual summaries within two tokens per frame. On StreamGaze, GazeLens achieves higher macro and micro accuracy than the evaluated full-grid and token-reduction baselines, with lower input-forward FLOPs than the shared-backbone token-reduction baselines.
blocks.zh: 智能眼镜可以帮助用户了解自己的活动和周围环境,但小型视觉语言模型必须在有限的计算中保存有用的证据. 这很困难,因为冗余帧消耗了视觉预算,而积极的空间压缩可以丢弃相关的细节. 虽然凝视能辨别穿戴者的焦点,但这个问题可能需要周围场景提供证据. 为了克服这些限制,我们提议加泽伦斯,将框架选择与目光和问题引导的减少符号相结合。 首先,HOG过渡和图像锐度在视觉编码之前选择帧. 对每个选定的框架,高斯集合将形成重点突出和互补的摘要。 因为它们的相关性取决于问题,一个轻量级的门将它们融合成一个主符. 这与全球场景标志一起,保留了每个框架两个标志内的重点和背景摘要。 在StreamGaze上,GazeLens实现的宏观和微观精确度高于评估的全网格和信使减少基线,输入前FLOP比共享后骨信使减少基线更低.

blocks.en: Smart glasses can help a wearer recall earlier actions, identify objects, or receive alerts about unfolding events ( Lee et al., 2025 ) . However, small vision-language models must retain useful evidence within limited compute and memory ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Chu et al., 2024 ) . Egocentric video makes this difficult because repeated views consume the visual budget, while useful evidence may occupy only a small region or a brief interval.
blocks.zh: 聪明的眼镜可以帮助佩戴者回忆先前的动作,识别物体,或收到关于正在发生事件的警报(Lee等人,2025年). 然而,小型视觉语言模型必须在有限的计算和记忆中保留有用的证据(姚等人,2024年;朱等人,2024年). 爱果中心视频使得这一点变得困难,因为反复的视图消耗了视觉预算,而有用的证据可能只占用一个小区域或短暂的间隔.

blocks.en: Reducing visual tokens addresses only part of this cost. FastV and PyramidDrop discard tokens inside the language model ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Xing et al., 2024 ) , after visual encoding and some language-model computation have already occurred. LLaMA-VID compresses each encoded frame to two tokens ( Li et al., 2024 ) , but still encodes every sampled frame. LongVU reduces both temporal and spatial redundancy ( Shen et al., 2024 ) , using DINOv2 features computed before frame removal. These choices save downstream computation while retaining the cost of extracting the features used for reduction. This motivates selecting frames before learned visual encoding when inexpensive image statistics can identify redundancy.
blocks.zh: 减少视觉信号只涉及这一费用的一部分。 FastV和PyramidDrop在语言模型内部丢弃符(Chen等人,2024b;Xing等人,2024),在视觉编码和一些语言模型计算已经发生之后. LLaMA-VID将每个编码框压缩为两个代号(Li et al., 2024),但仍然将每个抽样框编码. LongVU减少时间和空间冗余(Shen等人,2024年),使用帧清除前计算的DINOv2特性. 这些选择省去了下游的计算,同时保留了提取用于减少的特性的成本. 这激励了在学习到的视觉编码之前选择帧,当廉价图像统计能够识别冗余时.

blocks.en: Deciding what to preserve within a frame introduces a second difficulty. Gaze provides a spatial prior for the wearer’s focus ( Li et al., 2021 ; Zhang et al., 2017 ; Lai et al., 2024 ) . However, a question about a fixated object and a question about the surrounding scene require different evidence. A compact representation must therefore preserve both local and contextual information, with a balance that depends on the question.
blocks.zh: 决定在一个框架内保留什么,带来了第二个困难。 盖兹为穿戴者的焦点提供了空间前期(李等人,2021年;张等人,2017年;赖等人,2024年). 然而,关于固定物体的问题和关于周围场景的问题需要不同的证据. 因此,契约代表制必须既保存当地信息,又保存相关信息,并保持取决于问题的平衡。

blocks.en: Table 1 compares how reduction mechanisms address these requirements. LLaMA-VID conditions aggregation on the question without a gaze prior. GazeLLM crops around gaze ( Rekimoto, 2025 ) , removing off-gaze evidence. GazeVLM preserves global and local image views, then selects gaze-near and surrounding tokens with a preset allocation ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) . However, this allocation does not depend on the question. Voila-A retains gaze-conditioned features through a learned Perceiver ( Yan et al., 2024 ) , adding attention operations after encoding without reducing encoder inputs. These distinctions motivate combining frame selection before encoding with question-conditioned spatial compression that preserves scene context.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了减排机制如何满足这些要求。 LLaMA-VID 条件在这个问题上聚集,没有前视. (Rekimoto, 2025年), GazeVLM 保存全局和本地图像视图,然后选择带有预设分配的凝视近旁和周围的标志(Yoon et al., 2025 ). 然而,这种分配并不取决于这个问题。 Voila( 瓦伊拉语) A通过学习的Perceiver(Yan等人,2024年)保留了有目视条件的特性,在编码后增加注意操作,而不减少编码器输入. 这些区分激励了在编码前将帧选择与保留场景背景的带问题空间压缩相结合.

blocks.en: GazeLens implements these choices through three modules (Figure 1 ). To avoid encoding redundant or blurred candidates, Dynamic Frame Selection uses HOG transitions and Laplacian sharpness to select frames without learned parameters. To keep evidence beyond the fixation available, Focus-Aware Gaze Aggregation forms soft gaze-focused and complementary summaries. Question-Conditioned Semantic Gating then controls their mixture according to the question. This mixture forms the primary token, while a second, global token retains a scene summary regardless of the gate. Together, the modules reduce how many frames are encoded and control which information survives within two tokens per selected frame.
blocks.zh: GazeLens通过三个模块(图1)实施这些选择。 为了避免编码冗余或模糊的考生,Dynamic Frame Choice使用HOG过渡和Laplacian锐度来选择没有学到的参数的帧. 为了将证据保存在固定状态之外,Focus-Aware Gaze 聚合法形成了以目光为焦点的软性、互补的总结。 然后根据问题控制其混合物。 这种混合物构成主符,而第二,全局符则保留一个场景摘要,而不管门. 模块一起减少了多少帧被编码,并控制了每个选定框架在两个符号内生存的信息。

blocks.en: We make three contributions. • A parameter-free frame selector reduces encoder inputs using HOG transitions and image sharpness. • Gaze- and question-conditioned pooling preserves focused, complementary, and global summaries within two visual tokens per selected frame. • Our 500M configuration improves StreamGaze Macro and Micro accuracy over the evaluated baselines while reducing model-forward FLOPs. EgoGazeVQA transfer retains the frame-efficiency benefit.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。 • 支助 无参数框架选择器使用HOG过渡和图像锐度来减少编码器输入. • 盖兹和问题组合每个选定框架在两个视觉符号内保留重点突出、互补和全球摘要。 • 支助 我们的500M配置改进了StreamGaze Macro和微精度高于所评价的基线,同时降低了模型前传的FLOP. EgoGazeVQA转移保留了帧效率效益.

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: GazeLLM uses gaze-centered cropping ( Rekimoto, 2025 ) , while Voila-A learns gaze-conditioned visual representations ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . GazeVLM combines global/local image preprocessing with gaze-guided token selection after encoding ( Yoon et al., 2025 ) . It preserves surrounding evidence through sampled context tokens, but its image-based reduction does not select video frames or condition token allocation on the question. GazeLens instead selects frames before encoding and blends focused and complementary features according to the question within two tokens per frame. StreamGaze ( Lee et al., 2025 ) evaluates this balance through Past, Present, and Proactive questions.
blocks.zh: GazeLLM使用以凝视为中心的收割方式(Rekimoto, 2025年),而Voila-A学习以凝视为条件的视觉表现(Yan等人, 2024年). GazeVLM将全球/本地图像预处理与编码后的目视引导符号选择结合起来(Yoon等人,2025年). 它通过采样上下文符号来保存周围的证据,但其基于图像的还原不选择视频帧或问题的条件符号分配. GazeLens则在编码前选择帧,并根据每个帧的两个符号内的问题将焦点和互补特征混合. StreamGaze(Lee等人,2025年)通过过去、现在和积极主动的问题来评价这种平衡。

blocks.en: FastV and PyramidDrop prune visual tokens within the language model ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Xing et al., 2024 ) , whereas LLaMA-VID produces a compact representation before language-model input ( Li et al., 2024 ) . For video, LongVU and FrameFusion also exploit temporal redundancy in visual features ( Shen et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2024 ) . Frame-Voyager and M-LLM Frame Selector learn to choose frames using question relevance and model-derived supervision ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . Across these approaches, the stage of reduction determines which computation can be avoided. We therefore place frame selection before learned encoding and use gaze to allocate the retained spatial-token budget.
blocks.zh: fastV和PyramidDrop prune在语言模型中的视觉符号(Chen等人,2024b); Xing等人,2024 ),而LLaMA-VID则在语言模型输入之前制作紧凑的表示(Li等人,2024 ). 对于视频,LongVU和FrameFusion还利用视觉特征的时间冗余(Shen等人,2024年;Fu等人,2024年)。 Frame-Voyager和M-LLM Frame Selector学会利用问题相关性和模型产生的监督来选择框架(Yu等人,2024年;Hu等人,2025年)。 通过这些办法,削减阶段决定了可以避免的计算。 因此,我们在学会编码之前先放置框架选择,并使用目视来分配保留的空间数据预算。

blocks.en: VideoLLM-online, ViSpeak, Dispider, Flash-VStream, and LiveVLM address interaction with arriving video ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Ning et al., 2025 ) , with StreamingBench evaluating streaming comprehension ( Lin et al., 2024 ) . Our study concerns the visual input budget for each QA example. Here, frame selection controls the amount of encoded video, and gaze-conditioned pooling controls its spatial representation. Selected frames are encoded independently.
blocks.zh: VideoLLM-online, ViSpeak, Dispider, Flash-VStream, 和LiveVLM 与到达视频的地址互动(Chen等人,2024a; Fu等人,2025年;Qian等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2024年;Ning等人,2025年),其中Strewing Bench评价溪流理解(Lin等人,2024年). 我们的研究涉及每个质量保证实例的视觉投入预算。 在这里,帧选择控制了编码视频的量,视线有条件的集合控制了它的空间表现. 所选框架是独立编码的。

blocks.en: Each module in Figure 2 is motivated by a distinct failure mode of prior work. Uniform temporal sampling wastes the token budget on redundant or blurry frames before they ever reach the encoder, so Section 3.1 filters the candidate pool first. Hard gaze crops are brittle to sensor noise and silently drop peripheral context, so Section 3.2 instead builds complementary soft focus and unfocus tokens via Gaussian pooling. Because the right balance between gaze focus and peripheral evidence varies with the question, Section 3.3 introduces a scalar gate conditioned on question semantics to blend these tokens per sample. Section 3.4 details the final token assembly and training objective.
blocks.zh: 图2中的每个模块都以先前工作的明显失败模式为动力。 统一的时间采样将符号预算浪费在多余或模糊的框上,然后才到达编码器,因此第3.1节首先过滤候选集合. 坚硬的凝视作物对感应噪声微弱,无声地下降外围环境,因此第3.2节通过高斯池建立互补的软聚焦和无聚焦的标志. 由于凝视焦点和外围证据之间的适当平衡与问题不同,第3.3节引入了以问题语义为条件的scalar门,以混合每个样本的这些令牌. 第3.4节详细规定了最后的装配和培训目标。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dynamic Frame Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 动态框架选择

blocks.en: A fixed frame count imposes a single global trade-off. Too few frames miss rare action moments, and too many inflate the LM-side token budget with redundant content. We instead use a variable count t min ≤ T ≤ t max t_{\min}{\leq}T{\leq}t_{\max} , spending the budget only on frames where visual content actually changes. This flexibility favors frames that are both visually distinct from their neighbors and free of motion blur. We operationalize these two criteria with HOG transition cues and Laplacian sharpness scores, which are parameter-free, fast to compute, and require no training data.

blocks.en: Datasets & Metrics. We evaluate our method on StreamGaze ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , an egocentric video QA benchmark that we evaluate as three tasks, Past, Present, and Proactive, covering ten subtasks drawn from EGTEA Gaze+ ( Li et al., 2021 ) , EgoExo ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) , and HoloAssist ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Following the official partition, we train on 5,766 QA pairs and report final results on the held-out test split of 1,399 questions, yielding 2,418 evaluation examples after expanding proactive questions into timestamped probes. We adopt macro accuracy and micro accuracy as the primary evaluation metrics. Each task score averages its constituent subtask accuracies, and Macro is the equal-weight mean of the Past, Present, and Proactive scores. Micro is accuracy pooled over all test examples. To quantify model computation, we report TFLOPs per input forward under the controlled protocol in Appendix E.2 .

blocks.en: Baselines & Models. We compare our method against two groups of baselines. The first group consists of small VLMs evaluated without token reduction or gaze tuning, including SmolVLM2-256M and SmolVLM2-500M ( Marafioti et al., 2025 ) (our 256M and 500M backbones), FastVLM ( Vasu et al., 2025 ) , and Mobile-VideoGPT ( Shaker et al., 2025 ) . These represent the accuracy achievable with full token grids and standard inference pipelines, none of which were evaluated in the original StreamGaze report. The second group consists of token-reduction methods re-implemented on the SmolVLM2-500M framework for a controlled comparison of visual token budget and accuracy on identical hardware, namely GazeLLM ( Rekimoto, 2025 ) , LLaMA-VID ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and Voila-A ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . We use SmolVLM2-500M as the shared backbone to control for model capacity. We select these three because they each reduce visual tokens through distinct mechanisms. GazeLLM crops each frame to a fixed patch centered on the raw gaze point, discarding all peripheral context. LLaMA-VID produces two tokens per frame by combining one global mean over the feature grid with one context token formed by text-attended averaging over the full feature grid without any gaze prior. Voila-A feeds a gaze heatmap into a Perceiver resampler and mixes the resampled output with intermediate visual features.

blocks.en: Hyperparameters. Videos are first subsampled to 1 FPS before frame selection, normalizing the candidate pool across clips that vary widely in native frame rate. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed GazeLens for compact egocentric video question answering. First, adaptive frame selection uses HOG transitions and image sharpness to reduce temporal redundancy before visual encoding. Next, gaze-focused and complementary pooling preserve evidence within and beyond fixation, while a question-conditioned gate adjusts their contribution. A global summary then retains scene context alongside the primary token, yielding two visual tokens per selected frame. Together, these modules address the need to preserve relevant evidence within a limited visual budget. Future work could reuse visual tokens across frames with little change to reduce repeated computation during longer interactions. In addition, adapting the spatial token budget to the question and scene complexity could preserve finer details when needed.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出 GazeLens 为紧凑的自我中心视频问题回答。 首先,适应帧选择使用HOG过渡和图像锐度,以减少视觉编码之前的时间冗余. 其次,重点突出和互补的集合在固定内外保存证据,而以问题为条件的大门则调整其贡献。 然后,一个全局摘要与主符同时保留场景上下文,每个选定框产生两个视觉符。 这些模块共同解决了在有限的视觉预算内保存相关证据的必要性。 未来的工作可以跨框架重复使用视觉符号,很少改变,以减少在较长的相互作用期间的重复计算。 此外,根据问题和场景复杂性调整空间符号预算,可在需要时保留更细细的细节。

blocks.en: This work studies egocentric video and gaze data from existing benchmarks. Such data can expose private activities, bystanders, and patterns of attention. Potential applications include assistive visual interfaces, but gaze-conditioned systems could also enable intrusive monitoring. Access to gaze coordinates does not itself establish consent. Any deployment should obtain informed consent from affected users, limit data collection and retention, protect access to video and gaze records, and respect the source datasets’ usage conditions. blocks.en: We count input-forward computation at batch size one on an NVIDIA RTX 3080, using synthetic frames and a fixed question-and-options prompt. The native processed frame sizes are 512 × 512 512\times 512 for SmolVLM2, 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 for FastVLM, and 224 × 224 224\times 224 for both Mobile-VideoGPT vision encoders. SmolVLM2 and FastVLM use bfloat16, whereas Mobile-VideoGPT uses float16. Full-grid backbones are pretrained, and adapted SmolVLM2 methods add randomly initialized rank-eight LoRA adapters and method modules. Parameter values do not change the counted tensor shapes.

blocks.en: FLOPs cover supported operators in the vision encoders, token modules, and language model, including all prompt-position logits. A multiply-add counts as two operations, and grouped-query attention uses dense-equivalent attention arithmetic, including the full causal matrix convention. These are arithmetic counts, not hardware instruction counts. Video decoding, external frame selection, preprocessing, model loading, and autoregressive answer generation are excluded. Normalization and nonlinear operations are not included in the operator-counting convention.

blocks.en: Baselines use 16 frames. For both adaptive backbones, we count each frame length from 4 to 16 and weight it by the 2,418-example test-set selector distribution, averaging 12.72 12.72 frames per example. Per-example frame counts are identical across all three runs of both the 256M and 500M variants. The adaptive costs combine temporal selection and spatial compression.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: GazeLens targets devices with gaze sensors. When coordinates are missing, pooling becomes approximately uniform and loses the spatial prior that distinguishes attended content. A useful next step is to estimate gaze confidence and adapt the pooling rule when tracking is unreliable, so that uncertain fixation measurements do not determine the spatial representation.
blocks.zh: GazeLens瞄准了有视线传感器的装置. 当缺少坐标时,集合会变得大致一致,并失去区分被处理内容的空间前缀. 下一个有用的步骤是在跟踪不可靠时估计视线信心并调整集合规则,这样不确定的固定测量不会决定空间代表.

blocks.en: Temporal selection uses HOG transitions and image sharpness without conditioning on the question. Consequently, these cues can suppress visually repetitive frames that still contain relevant evidence. Future work could incorporate question relevance into selection while keeping its cost below that of encoding discarded frames. Selected frames are currently encoded independently, so reusing visual tokens across unchanged regions is another route to reducing repeated computation during longer interactions. Such extensions should be evaluated with end-to-end latency and memory measurements, since the reported model-forward FLOPs exclude frame selection, decoding, and preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 临时选择使用HOG的过渡和图像锐度,不附带问题条件. 因此,这些提示可以抑制仍然包含相关证据的视觉重复框架。 今后的工作可将问题的相关性纳入选择,同时将其成本保持在已丢弃框架的编码成本以下。 所选帧目前是独立编码的,因此重用跨未变区域的视觉符号是减少较长的相互作用期间重复计算的另一个途径. 这种扩展应用端到端的延时和内存测量来评价,因为所报告的模型前方FLOP排除了帧选择,解码和预处理.

blocks.en: Finally, two tokens per frame provide a compact input but can discard spatial detail needed for fine-grained reasoning. The spatial-budget comparisons motivate adapting token capacity to the question and scene complexity. Increasing capacity only when the task needs finer evidence could extend the present accuracy–computation trade-off, while retaining a compact representation for simpler inputs.
